text: man im glad you hit these same problems ive learned to fight around. it sucks major ass. mirror part: it finds the middle of the MESH not the middle. Mirror edits is even worse about that.
resolution: Confirmed the user's distinction with the live chair evidence: Mirror Part derives its plane from current mesh geometry bounds, so adding the one-sided feature shifts the very plane needed to reflect it (the chair became X -0.27..+0.37 and mirrored around +0.05 instead of X=0). Mirror Edits is more unstable because its effective plane changes with edit context. The durable fix direction is a stable explicit symmetry origin/plane, never a midpoint inferred from mutable geometry. This request records the diagnosed behavior; no code or model changes were made.
